description: This is a PHP source file defining a class named Header within the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Common. The class extends a base Controller class from the Opencart System Engine and contains a single method index() that constructs and returns data for rendering the common header of an OpenCart storefront, including meta tags, styles, scripts, links, and various dynamic components such as navigation, account links, cart info, and language/currency controls.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating the header section of the storefront with dynamic data such as site info, navigation, and user account links.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates and returns the rendered header view with all necessary data including site info, navigation links, user account links, cart info, and scripts/styles.
